name: Infant Ear Molding of New Hampshire, LLC
description: Infant Ear Molding of New Hampshire, LLC offers professional ear molding service which can help correct the shape of your child’s ears. This noninvasive, nonmedical service involves using a malleable splint to hold the ear cartilage in the corrected shape until the cartilage hardens around 3 months of age.  This can help to avoid years of teasing, psychosocial stress and the need for surgery in the future. Ear molding is a comfortable and straightforward process which usually takes 6 weeks.
